groups.title: Surfaces & depth
groups.description: Build hierarchy through quiet tonal steps. Use deep and sunken surfaces for sidebars and wells; raised surfaces for cards and controls.

tokens.name: surface-deep
tokens.description: Deepest navigation, media, or code surface.

tokens.name: surface-sunken
tokens.description: Inset wells, grouped controls, and sidebars.

tokens.name: popover
tokens.description: Opaque menu, dialog, tooltip, and popover surface.

tokens.name: muted
tokens.description: Quiet grouping, hover, and neutral emphasis.

tokens.name: surface-raised
tokens.description: Highest blue surface for active areas and layered panels.

tokens.name: overlay
tokens.description: 80% dark scrim behind modal surfaces; not a text background.

groups.title: Text & links
groups.description: Three readable text levels on every standard dark surface. Use semantic text tokens instead of opacity.

tokens.name: foreground-subtle
tokens.description: Tertiary text that remains readable on raised surfaces.

tokens.name: link
tokens.description: Inline links; also provide an underline.

groups.title: Actions & selection
groups.description: Explicit resting, hover, and pressed states for clear hierarchy without introducing decorative colour.

tokens.name: primary-foreground
tokens.description: Primary action text and icons in every state.

tokens.name: secondary-foreground
tokens.description: Secondary action text in every state.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.description: Emphasized rows and hoverable list items.

tokens.name: selected
tokens.description: Selected row or tab; pair with a check, border, or label.

groups.title: Boundaries & focus
groups.description: Quiet dividers are decorative. Use strong borders for meaningful control boundaries and a separate focus ring for keyboard navigation.

tokens.name: border
tokens.description: Decorative card outlines and dividers; not a control boundary.

tokens.name: border-strong
tokens.description: Meaningful boundaries on standard dark surfaces.

tokens.name: ring
tokens.description: Keyboard focus on dark surfaces; use an offset gap.

tokens.name: ring-inverse
tokens.description: Keyboard focus when the surrounding surface is light.

groups.title: Disabled states
groups.description: Use explicit fills and text instead of fading an entire control. Always pair styling with native disabled or appropriate aria-disabled behaviour.

groups.title: Feedback & status
groups.description: Reserve colour for meaning. Pair each status with a label or icon; use the matching foreground for filled badges and text token for subtle alerts.

tokens.name: destructive
tokens.description: Destructive action or error badge fill.

tokens.name: destructive-foreground
tokens.description: Text on destructive fills in every state.

tokens.name: destructive-text
tokens.description: Error text on dark and destructive-subtle surfaces.

tokens.name: success-text
tokens.description: Success text on dark and success-subtle surfaces.

tokens.name: warning-text
tokens.description: Warning text on dark and warning-subtle surfaces.

tokens.name: info-text
tokens.description: Informational text on dark and info-subtle surfaces.

groups.title: Growth surfaces
groups.description: Yellow identifies the growth intervention; surrounding context keeps the blue theme. Use a label or explanation as well as colour. Surface depth stays light enough for shared dark text.

tokens.name: growth-background
tokens.description: Default yellow canvas within a focused growth component.

tokens.name: growth-surface-deep
tokens.description: Strongest yellow inset or media well; use dark growth text.

tokens.name: growth-surface-sunken
tokens.description: Inset growth content and grouped controls.

tokens.name: growth-popover
tokens.description: Opaque yellow menu, dialog, tooltip, or educational popover.

tokens.name: growth-muted
tokens.description: Quiet yellow grouping and neutral emphasis.

tokens.name: growth-inverse-foreground
tokens.description: Light text on dark growth inverse surfaces.

tokens.name: growth-overlay
tokens.description: Dark yellow-brown modal scrim; never a text surface.

groups.title: Growth text & links
groups.description: Dark yellow-brown ink remains readable across all light growth surfaces. Muted text is a colour token, never reduced opacity.

tokens.name: growth-foreground
tokens.description: Primary growth headings, labels, and content.

tokens.name: growth-foreground-subtle
tokens.description: Tertiary growth text; readable even on selected yellow surfaces.

tokens.name: growth-link
tokens.description: Growth inline links; also underline them.

tokens.name: growth-link-hover
tokens.description: Hovered or focused growth inline links.

groups.title: Growth actions & selection
groups.description: Use dark primary actions and yellow secondary actions. Retain checks, borders, and labels for selection so colour is supplementary.

tokens.name: growth-primary-foreground
tokens.description: Primary growth action label across all states.

tokens.name: growth-secondary-foreground
tokens.description: Secondary growth action label across all states.

tokens.name: growth-accent
tokens.description: Emphasized growth rows and hoverable list items.

tokens.name: growth-selected
tokens.description: Selected growth row or tab; pair with a check, border, or label.

groups.title: Growth boundaries & focus
groups.description: Use strong borders for meaningful control boundaries. A dark focus ring needs an offset gap, especially around dark primary actions.

tokens.name: growth-border
tokens.description: Decorative yellow card outlines and dividers; not a control boundary.

tokens.name: growth-border-strong
tokens.description: Meaningful control boundaries on light growth surfaces.

tokens.name: growth-input
tokens.description: Growth inputs and unselected control outlines.

tokens.name: growth-ring
tokens.description: Keyboard focus on light growth surfaces; use an offset gap.

tokens.name: growth-ring-inverse
tokens.description: Keyboard focus when the surrounding growth surface is dark.

groups.title: Growth highlights on blue
groups.description: Yellow accents for growth metadata in the blue library. These text roles are for blue surfaces, not the light yellow intervention theme.

tokens.name: growth-highlight
tokens.description: Yellow title verbs and goal icons on supported blue library surfaces.

groups.title: Growth feedback
groups.description: Feedback retains its error, success, warning, or information hue. Light feedback surfaces and dark text adapt those existing meanings to the yellow theme.

tokens.name: growth-destructive-subtle
tokens.description: Light error alert surface within growth components.

tokens.name: growth-destructive-text
tokens.description: Dark error text on light growth and error surfaces.

tokens.name: growth-success-subtle
tokens.description: Light success alert surface within growth components.

tokens.name: growth-success-text
tokens.description: Dark success text on light growth and success surfaces.

tokens.name: growth-warning-subtle
tokens.description: Light warning alert surface within growth components.

tokens.name: growth-warning-text
tokens.description: Dark warning text on light growth and warning surfaces.

tokens.name: growth-info-subtle
tokens.description: Light informational alert surface within growth components.

tokens.name: growth-info-text
tokens.description: Dark informational text on light growth and information surfaces.
